usdRate.sourceName: BCEAO, rates of foreign currencies against the CFA franc for transfers, 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: Mid-point of the buying (585.50) and selling (592.50) rates for the US dollar; the CFA franc is pegged at 655.957 per euro. World Bank 2025 average 581.9.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing INStaD consumer price index, September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 1.9% year on year in September 2026 after 0.1% in August (secondary source); the BCEAO monthly note of October 2026 confirms 0.1% for August (0.0% in July).

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCEAO inflation target (1-3% band, centre 2%); UMOA inflation 1.3% in August 2026
inflation_projection.note: Benin's inflation has stayed low and the CFA franc is pegged to the euro, so the centre of the BCEAO's 1-3% target band, 2%, is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, key rates (minimum bid rate for refinancing tenders), effective 16 March 2026
policy_rate.note: Main policy rate 3.00%, held at the 9 September 2026 committee; the marginal lending facility rate is 5.00%. Common to all eight UMOA countries.

savings_account_rate.note: No average rate on ordinary savings accounts in Benin was found; the BCEAO bank-conditions survey (first half 2026) lists term-deposit and contractual-savings rates only.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Benin)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Median of the minimum term-deposit rates (taux DAT minimum) that Benin's 15 banks declare to the BCEAO, range 2.0-4.0%; the minimum usually applies to small, short deposits. Not a tenor-specific average.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The BCEAO bank-conditions survey gives only minimum (median 3.5%) and maximum (median 5.75%, range 5.0-7.0%) term-deposit rates per bank in Benin for the first half of 2026, not a 1-year rate.

dps_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Benin)
dps_rate.note: Median rate on contractual savings plans (épargne contractuelle) declared by Benin's banks in the first half of 2026; most declare 3.50% (range 3.5-5.0%).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, monthly economic note for UMOA countries, September 2026 (bank deposit rates, July 2026)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average deposit rate across UMOA banks, 5.15% in July 2026 (5.12% in June); Benin's rate rose 0.20 points in the month, but the BCEAO does not publish the country level in this note.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate sold to individuals was found; the Treasury borrows through UMOA-Titres auctions of bills and bonds, open to individuals only through banks and brokers.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Benin Treasury bill auction of 13 August 2026 (3 months)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average yield 3.06% (weighted average rate 3.0364%) on 3-month bills maturing 12 November 2026; the UMOA-Titres zero-coupon curve of 23 October 2026 gives 3.13% at 3 months.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Benin yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026
tbond_5y_rate.note: 5-year zero-coupon rate 6.71% (6.57% after smoothing); Benin's last 5-year auction (22 January 2026) yielded 6.68%.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Benin yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026
tbond_10y_rate.note: 10-year zero-coupon rate 7.30% (7.43% after smoothing); Benin has not auctioned a 10-year bond in 2026, so this point is extrapolated from the curve.

tax_bank_interest.note: The Benin tax authority site (impots.finances.gouv.bj) could not be reached and PwC Tax Summaries has no Benin page, so the withholding rate on bank interest could not be confirmed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists, and the tax treatment of interest on Benin Treasury securities for individuals could not be confirmed from an official source.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: UMOA Council of Ministers, Decision No. 009 of 30 June 2017 on FGDR-UMOA contribution rates and compensation ceilings
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Deposits are guaranteed up to 1,400,000 FCFA per depositor per bank (300,000 FCFA at a microfinance institution) by the regional deposit guarantee fund; the decision dates from 2017 (older than 2025) and is still the one the fund publishes.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions débitrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Benin)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Maximum lending rate (taux débiteur maximum) declared by most Benin banks for the first half of 2026 (range 11-14%); it applies to all bank credit, including cards. No card-specific rate is published.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (regional stock exchange BRVM, deposit rates)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: regional (BRVM) equities return about the bank deposit rate, as in their weak 2016-2020 years.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026; UMOA-Titres Benin yield curve
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3.5 points above after-tax term deposits and 1-year government bills (about 4.5%), within the 4-point cap; the BRVM's equity capitalisation rose 65.7% in the year to August 2026 but its 10-year record is uneven.

equity_return_high.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (BRVM market capitalisation)
equity_return_high.note: High case: the BRVM repeats a strong decade like 2023-2026.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO exchange rates (CFA franc pegged to the euro)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold in euro terms.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO exchange rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus a small allowance for the euro-pegged franc weakening against the dollar.

gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years such as 2024-2025.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Benin)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at the 3.5% floor rate, less a possible tax on interest.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Benin yield curve (1 year 6.3%); BCEAO bank conditions (term deposits 3.5-5.75%)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: larger term deposits (median maximum 5.75%) or 1-year Treasury bills (6.3%) through a bank, less tax on interest, rounded down because the tax rate is unconfirmed.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 3-5 year Treasury bonds or regional public bond issues at 6.5-7%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: CIMA (the regional insurance regulator) and Benin's insurance directorate publish no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Temporary death cover is sold under the CIMA code, but no published premium rates per 1,000 FCFA of cover by age were found from a public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Benin was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Benin
oop_health_share.note: 42.4% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (UMOA health prices); inflation assumption 2%
goal_inflation_health.note: No reliable national medical CPI series was read; private medical costs usually rise faster than general prices, so 1.5 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BCEAO monthly economic note, September 2026 (UMOA education prices); inflation assumption 2%
goal_inflation_education.note: No reliable national education CPI series was read; private school fees usually rise faster than general prices, so 2 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Benin

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.67 (2025, World Bank), 6.6 (2040) and 10.0 (2065, populationpyramid.net/benin/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: CLEISS (French social security liaison body), the Benin social security system for employees: CNSS old-age pension
retirement_age_default.note: CNSS old-age pension at 60 with 180 months of insurance (55 for premature wear); early pension up to 5 years before, reduced 5% a year. Source is dated 2024 (older than 2025); the CNSS site could not be reached.

retirement_age_government.note: No official source for the current retirement age of Benin civil servants could be read (the public service ministry and pension fund sites were not reached).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Benin)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at about 3.5%, less a possible tax on interest.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Benin)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits at 3.5-5.75% less tax on interest; below the after-tax 1-year deposit and Treasury bill rates.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in short Treasury bonds bought through a bank.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Benin)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about after-tax deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Benin yield curve; equity base 8%; gold base 4.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits or Treasury bonds, regional equity funds and some gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Benin yield curve; equity high 12%

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension for Benin was found; the CLEISS summary of Benin social security describes none, but no source confirming that none exists was read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found (see old_age_allowance_monthly).

gratuity_rule.note: No official text on a statutory end-of-service or retirement indemnity for private employees in Benin could be read (the Labour Code and collective agreement were not reached).

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: CLEISS (French social security liaison body), the Benin social security system for employees: CNSS old-age pension
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory CNSS pension for private employees: 30% of the average wage of the last 5 years after 180 months of insurance, plus 2% per extra 12 months, at least 60% of the minimum wage and at most 80% of the average wage; a lump sum of one month's wage per year of insurance if fewer than 180 months. No automatic indexation (one-off 1-20% revaluation in 2023 by Decree 2023-455). Source dated 2024 (older than 2025).

fdr_3m.note: Banks declare minimum and maximum term-deposit rates to the BCEAO twice a year.

fdr_1y.note: Banks declare minimum and maximum term-deposit rates to the BCEAO twice a year.

dps.note: Monthly savings plans (housing or project savings) offered by banks.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by UMOA-Titres; individuals buy through banks or licensed brokers (SGI).

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned by UMOA-Titres; individuals buy through banks or licensed brokers (SGI).

tbond_10y.note: Benin has issued 3-7 year bonds on the regional market in 2026; longer bonds are rare.

equity_fund.note: Supervised by the regional financial market authority (AMF-UMOA); equity funds invest on the regional exchange (BRVM).

gold.note: Gold is mainly bought as jewellery; bars and coins are uncommon.

centralBank.name: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (BCEAO)

insuranceRegulator.name: Commission Régionale de Contrôle des Assurances (CIMA)
insuranceRegulator.note: Regional insurance regulator for the CIMA member states; Benin's insurance directorate is in the Ministry of Economy and Finance.

pensionScheme.name: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), old-age pension

publicHealthCover.name: Assurance pour le Renforcement du Capital Humain (ARCH), Agence Nationale de Protection Sociale (ANPS)

depositInsurance.name: Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution dans l'UMOA (FGDR-UMOA)

statistics.name: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INStaD)
